title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1982-09-18
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-8 (w/no Dolby) > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644
source: 2x Nakamichi CM300's with CP4 shotguns (L R), plus 1x Nakamichi CM300 with CP1 cardioid (blend mic) > Nakamichi 550 > Maxell XLII-S 90's. Mics on stand, set up in center right section riser, just off the floor.

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1982 Garden show captured on a surprisingly clear audience tape with standout Jack Straw → Sugaree opening and a superb second set.
ai_review.review: The audience recording from the Garden delivers unusually good clarity for that venue, preserving Jerry Garcia’s strong vocals and guitar work throughout. Fans rave about the fiery first‑set opener (Jack Straw into Sugaree), the “West L.A.” jam, Dupree’s Diamond back‑to‑back run, a tight U.S. Blues transition and a mellow Baby Blue encore, making this one of the stronger shows of the 1982 run.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 4‑5 stars and praised both the musical performance (high energy, standout songs) and the surprisingly good audience recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Despite the Garden’s reputation for poor acoustics, reviewers note a clear, well‑balanced capture that retains the show’s energy; no major dropouts or muffling reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, upbeat first set leading into a superb second set with tight transitions and a relaxed encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His voice sounds particularly good and his guitar playing is described as fantastic.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob dedicated “Samson” to the building, showing his usual rapport with the crowd.
